title: Agent Trace Event (one JSON object per line in .sdlc/traces/YYYY-MM-DD/<session>.jsonl)
description: Written by scripts/sdlc_hook.py from Claude Code / Codex hook events. Secrets are redacted and long values truncated before writing. `ts` is the machine's local time with a UTC offset (e.g. +07:00 in Bangkok) unless SDLC_TRACE_TZ=utc. `operation` names follow OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions where one exists (invoke_agent, execute_tool). Fields added after the first release are all optional, so schema version 1 stays valid.

ts.description: Local time with offset, millisecond precision, e.g. 2026-11-21T12:34:56.789+07:00

event.description: Hook event name, e.g. PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, UserPromptSubmit, PermissionRequest, ConfigChange, TraceConfigChange

role.description: agent_type from the payload, else SDLC_ACTIVE_ROLE, else main

model.description: Model in use, e.g. claude-opus-5-5, or 'unknown'

model_source.description: payload = reported by this very event; state = last value remembered for the session; env = ANTHROPIC_MODEL

effort.description: Reasoning effort level, e.g. low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Absent when the platform does not expose it (Codex hooks)

subagent_model.description: Model a subagent actually used (Agent tool response)

prompt_id.description: Claude Code prompt id; matches `prompt.id` in Claude Code OpenTelemetry events

permission_mode.description: default, plan, acceptEdits, auto, dontAsk or bypassPermissions

summary.description: Short argument summary for tools without command/path (e.g. MCP tools)

input_raw.description: Full tool_input as JSON text (debug level only)

error_type.description: StopFailure error class, e.g. rate_limit, authentication_failed, billing_error, server_error

status.description: Codex model request status: completed, failed or cancelled

token_usage.description: Codex per-request token counts (numeric fields only)

tool_count.description: Number of tool calls in a PostToolBatch

source.description: SessionStart source (startup, resume, clear, compact, fork)

switch_source.description: Model switch trigger: command, picker, sdk, auto, resume

file_path.description: File affected by ConfigChange / InstructionsLoaded / FileChanged / DirectoryAdded
